countystatisticsid: Unique identifier for each county statistics record, used for data management and referencing.
distributiondate: Date when the statistics were distributed or reported, providing a time context for the data.
countyallemployees: Total number of employees in the county, measured in individuals. Indicates the size of the local workforce.
countytotalestablishment: Total number of business establishments in the county, measured in units. Reflects the level of economic activity and diversity in the area.
countyname: Name of the county for which the statistics are reported, allowing for geographical identification and analysis.
